dedupe_keys.name: us potable water reuse system costs dataset nawi doe osti

description: This dataset compiles US potable reuse capital and operations and maintenance cost data in 2020 dollars, taken from published presentations and reports of engineering consultants, utility and water agency press releases and websites, and literature. It was made by Alison Sim and Meagan Mauter for the National Alliance for Water Innovation and released through the DOE Data Explorer in October 2020 with a DOI. The set mixes facility-specific costs and total capital costs including conveyance infrastructure and does not give detailed cost breakdowns for each facility; the submission also includes the source documents as PDF. For facilities not yet built, the costs are mostly engineer estimates that may change during construction. Coverage: US potable reuse projects, cost by facility. Access: free through the DOE record; the licence is not stated on the page read. Caveats: heterogeneous sources and estimates, and no component breakdown. It supports cost and capacity planning of advanced water treatment and reuse in optimisation models, and relates to the Orange County GWRS case study in the catalogue.
